paper.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side on notional, fill at the confirmation candle close. One open position per coin. Use Trade settings for timeframe, TP, cooldown, leverage, size, and DCA.

paper_unconfirmed.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side on notional. Enters at the close of the candle when a new unconfirmed BUY?/SELL? first appears. If that signal fades, the position stays open. DCA legs match the first leg. Use Trade settings for timeframe, TP, cooldown, leverage, size, and DCA.
